outcome: The player who creates a token owns it and controls it as it enters the battlefield.
A created token has exactly the characteristics its creating effect defines and no others.
A created token's name is its subtype(s) plus Token unless the effect names it; renaming does not change subtypes and vice versa.
A token whose characteristics a rule or effect forbids on the battlefield is not created, and a token copy of an instant or sorcery card is not created.
A token is affected by effects that affect permanents or its card type or subtype, and is not a card.
A token in a zone other than the battlefield ceases to exist at the next state-based check, after any leaves-the-battlefield triggers have triggered.
A token that has left the battlefield stays in its current zone instead of moving again, and ceases to exist at the next state-based check.

note: A legendary token is created as a token with the given name and characteristics; 111.3 and 111.4 cover the outcome.
